diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/subdialog.css b/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/subdialog.css
index 66d12a5479b..68280c439f0 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/subdialog.css
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/subdialog.css
@@ -85,3 +85,7 @@ xul|window > :is(xul|dialog, xul|hbox, xul|vbox) {
   flex: 1;
   min-height: 100vh;
 }
+
+#selectOffline {
+  background-color: var(--in-content-page-background);
+}
diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/msgSelectOfflineFolders.xhtml b/mailnews/base/content/msgSelectOfflineFolders.xhtml
index 2c1e7e6b391..592f1dda28c 100644

@@ -12,8 +12,7 @@
   xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
   windowtype="mailnews:selectOffline"
   lightweightthemes="true"
-  width="450"
-  height="400"
+  style="min-width: 50ch; height: 400px"
   persist="width height screenX screenY"
   scrolling="false"
 >
@@ -42,6 +41,7 @@
   </head>
   <html:body
     xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
